method: Actual runtime read-call/output pairs only, JSON output fields decoded and declared nl -ba prefixes removed; otherwise exact ordered contiguous line blocks. Source selector requires the input basename in the read call. Calls writing generated reports are excluded. Establishes delivered text, not cognitive attention or factual correctness.

publisher_json_representation.representation_note: Full rules and embedded FAQ text is proven through exact TXT line delivery and independent JSON text+newline equivalence. Complete raw JSON serialization and links array are not claimed delivered. Metadata is checked against actual parsed-object output, excluding text and links.
